🇺🇸 To the veterans and military families of Northern Colorado — thank you.

We made it official: SAA Homes pledges 0.5% of our commission back to every veteran and active-duty client at closing. You choose how it's applied — extended warranty, closing costs, or a price reduction.

New resources to help you buy or sell:
• Veterans hub & pledge details → https://saahomes.com/veterans/
• VA loan guide for Colorado → https://saahomes.com/blog/va-loan-colorado-guide/
• Military relocation guide → https://saahomes.com/blog/military-relocation-northern-colorado/

Adam & Mandi Schwartz | SAA Homes
(970) 999-1407
